description: Explicit allowlist for Microsoft source families that remain Missing only because their product responsibility is deliberately deferred beyond the already-completed Rust ownership slices. Any effective Missing contract outside this list fails the global inventory gate.

sources.reason: The two CopyRequest/GetPlainText extraction contracts now have a safe Rust owner and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses, but the canonical R06-A equivalence entries still need in-place promotion before the global census may honestly retire them; keyboard/platform methods remain separately Platform-only.
Only ReadingDbcsCharsPadsOutputArray remains: Rust owns DBCS padding/order once encoded bytes are supplied, but CP_JAPANESE conversion remains a Windows codepage adapter responsibility.
Safe Rust now owns the screen-buffer reflow-color and tab-stop seams; the remaining methods require other cursor/viewport/renderer/selection/API coordination seams.
The C++ iterator operator API has no direct migrated Rust product abstraction.
Terminal application command-line behavior remains native product logic.
Filtered-command product action semantics remain native.
TerminalApp settings integration remains native product logic.
